description:
The next-generation user interface for all automotive USB PC Oscilloscopes, including all the analysis tools you need to get answers quickly, whether carrying out a simple test, or debugging a complex design.


New features:
- Newly added Action Event to trigger on your Serial Decoders, allowing you to stop a capture, save a file, or play an alarm, the moment specific serial data or errors are decoded. Perfect for unattended monitoring of intermittent bus faults.
- Now possible to manually adjust the ranges of a custom probe when creating or editing a probe, allowing the setup of uni-polar or more specific ranges.
- Added a new OWI serial decoder.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed an issue where CAN FD decoder would sometimes stop continuous decoding after encountering an error in the data.
- Resolved an issue where the UI could lockup when the Math Channel options panel was open.
- Time values that exceed 1 minute now consistently formatted for easier reading (e.g., 1d 2h 30m 15s).
